items.title: Routing Middleware now supports Python
items.summary: You can now write  in Python for FastAPI, Flask, Django, and other Python frameworks. It runs before requests reach your app, and can rewrite, redirect, or answer them.routing middlewareTo set it up, point the  entrypoint in  at your proxy:proxyvercel.tomlYour middleware is an ASGI or WSGI app that runs separately from your main app, with only the packages in the  dependency group of your . Add the packages your middleware imports to that group:vercel.proxypyproject.tomlThe  package provides utilities for writing routing middleware on Vercel, including a  app that routes requests by path:vercel-proxyProxyRequests that match no route continue to your app unchanged.For more information, see the .Routing Middleware Python referenceRead more
